# Scrapbook materials

Created 13 October 2026 using image_gen for the authorized birthday scrapbook brief.

- `atlas.webp`: original generated four-quadrant material scan. Ivory laid paper, dusty-pink linen, blush cardstock, pale pink gingham.
- `paper.webp`: separate image_gen edit from the original atlas, recreating the ivory paper with subtle laid fibers.
- `linen.webp`: separate image_gen edit from the original atlas, recreating the dusty-pink woven cover cloth.
- All three are 1254 x 1254 pixels. Original PNGs remain in `/workspace/scratch/scrapbook-assets-v5`. Production files are WebP encodings at quality 82 for delivery; no crop, resize, lettering, objects, or compositional changes were added during encoding.
- No third-party image was supplied as a generation reference. No third-party stock license is claimed. These are newly generated project assets.
- All images were inspected visually. Final browser captures check material scale and seams at phone and desktop sizes. Texture repeats use a constant CSS scale; low opacity beneath text retains legibility.
